questions.question: Which technique does APT28 use for initial access?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT28 uses Spearphishing Attachment (T1566.001) for initial access.

questions.question: Which technique does APT29 use for initial access?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT29 uses Spearphishing Attachment (T1566.001) for initial access.

questions.question: Which sectors does APT28 target?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT28 targets the Government and Defense Contractors sectors.

questions.question: Which sectors does APT29 target?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT29 targets the Government and Healthcare sectors.

questions.question: Which malware is used by APT28?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT28 uses X-Agent, Zebrocy, and Cobalt Strike.

questions.question: Which malware is used by APT29?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT29 uses WellMess and Cobalt Strike.

questions.question: Which campaign is attributed to APT29?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Operation Ghost is attributed to APT29.

questions.question: Which campaign is attributed to APT28?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Sofacy 2020 Intrusion Set is attributed to APT28.

questions.question: Which techniques are associated with malware used by APT28?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Malware used by APT28 employs Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059), Application Layer Protocol (T1071), Spearphishing Attachment (T1566.001), and Exploitation of Remote Services (T1210).

questions.question: Which techniques are associated with malware used by APT29?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Malware used by APT29 employs Application Layer Protocol (T1071) and Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059).

questions.question: Which vulnerabilities are exploited by malware used by APT28?
Which vulnerabilities are exploited by malware used by APT29?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT29's WellMess malware exploits CVE-2021-26855, and Cobalt Strike (also used by APT29) exploits CVE-2020-4006.

questions.question: Which vulnerabilities are connected to malware used by threat actors that employ Spearphishing Attachment?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Threat actors employing Spearphishing Attachment (APT28 and APT29) use malware (Zebrocy, X-Agent, Cobalt Strike, WellMess) that collectively exploits CVE-2020-0688, CVE-2020-4006, and CVE-2021-26855.

questions.question: Which threat actors use malware that exploits vulnerabilities affecting Microsoft Exchange Server, and which attack techniques are involved?
questions.ground_truth_answer: APT28 (via Zebrocy exploiting CVE-2020-0688) and APT29 (via WellMess exploiting CVE-2021-26855) both target Microsoft Exchange Server; involved techniques include Spearphishing Attachment, Exploitation of Remote Services, Application Layer Protocol, and Command and Scripting Interpreter.

questions.question: Which techniques are used by malware associated with campaigns attributed to APT29?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Operation Ghost (attributed to APT29) uses WellMess, which employs Application Layer Protocol (T1071) and Command and Scripting Interpreter (T1059).

questions.question: Which products are affected by vulnerabilities exploited by malware used in campaigns attributed to APT28?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Sofacy 2020 Intrusion Set (attributed to APT28) uses Zebrocy, which exploits CVE-2020-0688, affecting Microsoft Exchange Server.
